title: Connected manufacturing improvement journey acceptance
countPolicy: Separate MIW-NEW-01 expanded cohort; original351 untouched. NOT_RUN/BLOCKED preparation rows are not acceptance or padded historicalPASS.
prerequisites: Owner provides frozen deployed candidate identity and visible local route/control map.

Owner provides isolated synthetic case with declared canonical operands, raw overlapping events, effective documents, hypotheses/actions/work proof, compatible before/after and sustainment branches. No reviewer invents missing evidence.
Freeze independent expected-value oracle and definitions before execution; approve proposed plant semantics explicitly.
LLM disabled throughout full journey; no credentials/provider calls/external dispatch/security controls.
Native backups and restore procedure for every owned namespace.
